evidence.quote: We derive a total CO(2-1) flux of $174\pm17$ Jy km s$^{-1}$ from these data, in agreement with the estimate from our combined dataset.

analysis_steps.goal: Moment maps, PVD and continuum source measurement

evidence.quote: based on 3 million iterations

analysis_steps.goal: Forward-model gas kinematics to measure BH mass

method.value: KinMS with KinMS_MCMC fit to the high-res cube within 0.25" (3.7 pc); circular rotation, constant dispersion, BH point mass plus stars (Gamma prior) plus gas

evidence.quote: To do this we concentrate on the molecular gas disc/torus within a radius of 0$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$25 (or $\approx$3.7 pc) from the centre of NGC 404.

key_parameters.value: log MBH prior uniform 4.0-6.9; Gamma Gaussian (0.61, 0.11); inclination Gaussian (37, 3); noise scaled by (2N)^(1/4)=12.47 with N=12,112

evidence.quote: this equates to increasing the RMS by a factor of 12.47

assumptions.value: circular orbits, thin disc, constant velocity dispersion, no dark matter

evidence.quote: In this work we assume that the molecular gas is in circular motion

fitting.value: MCMC with Gibbs sampling and adaptive stepping; log-likelihood -chi2/2 plus log priors; final chain 300,000 steps with 10% burn-in; median and 68%/99% CLs

evidence.quote: the best chain is run (with a fixed step size) for 300,000 steps (with a 10% burn-in)

validation.value: PVDs and velocity-field residuals; models with no BH or >1e6 Msun fail

evidence.quote: a model without an IMBH cannot provide a good fit to our data, nor can a BH of mass $\raisebox{-0.6ex}{$\,\stackrel{\raisebox{-.2ex}{$\textstyle >$}}{\sim}\,$}10^6$ M$_{\odot}$

method.value: Velocity dispersion gradient, asymmetric drift estimate, free disc thickness, varying alpha_CO, Gamma prior removal

findings_qualitative.value: Central disc/torus of molecular gas within ~5 pc rotates around the BH, surrounded by a warped arm and incomplete ring of radius ~40 pc

evidence.quote: The disc itself is rotating around the IMBH, but is surrounded by kinematically-distinct lopsided emission that appears connected to an arm-like feature.

findings_qualitative.value: Continuum likely dominated by Rayleigh-Jeans dust emission

evidence.quote: We consider it likely that the majority of this emission is from the Rayleigh-Jeans tail of the dust continuum

claims.experiment: JAM re-fit with MGE of gas added to the stellar mass model

evidence.quote: This best-fitting BH mass is significantly higher than that previously derived from the same data

claims.hypothesis: Cold molecular gas kinematics independently require an IMBH

claims.hypothesis: Systematics do not bias the gas-based BH mass

why_this_data.value: High resolution resolves BH sphere of influence but resolves out flux, so combined data used for morphology

evidence.quote: This dataset allows us to image the central disc at the highest spatial resolution possible, but it does not recover all the flux.

why_this_method.value: Clean-component gas distribution used because gas is clearly not axisymmetric

evidence.quote: As the molecular gas distribution in NGC 404 is clearly not axisymmetric we here utilise a different approach

limitations_admitted.value: Keplerian rise not resolved; result depends on stellar mass model and Gamma

evidence.quote: We therefore suggest that the low $\Gamma$ value should be treated with caution.
